entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, agent ID 401. How can I help you with your VeloFit gear today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I need to return this helmet I bought. This is completely unacceptable.
I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied. To get started, could I have your order number?
It's 8675309. I don't know why it's so hard. I just want to return it. I expect a full refund, now.

Thank you, I have your order pulled up. I see the Pro-Weave Helmet, purchased 62 days ago. To understand how to best help, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Are you kidding me? The issue is that the color is completely wrong! It's not what it looked like online at all. It's a safety issue if it doesn't match my high-visibility kit! I haven't even touched it, the box is unopened!
I understand your frustration with the color not meeting your expectations. Let me just review the return eligibility for you.
Review? There's nothing to review! I want my money back! This is absurd. Get me your manager, right now. I'm about to post a review about this terrible service on every website I can find.

Sir, I understand you're upset, and there's no need for a manager. Please give me just one moment. Okay, I've checked our policy. Since you received the helmet 62 days ago, it is still unfortunately outside our 10-day return window for standard items. I can absolutely process this return for you for a full refund.
Oh. Well... okay then. So you're going to approve it?

Yes, absolutely. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to the email address on file right now. You should receive it within the next five minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the original packaging, and drop it off at any postal service location. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed.
Fine. That's what you should have said in the first place. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
